summary: Tenon Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that following a public offering of $4.2 million of common stock and warrants on July 1, 2026, it believes it now satisfies Nasdaq's minimum stockholders' equity requirement for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market. The filing reports a prior non-compliance notice dated May 21, 2026, and notes Nasdaq will monitor compliance at the September 30, 2026 Quarterly Report. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation.
